subject: Post-discovery: schedule half-hour product preview + stakeholder availability
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aureliasystems.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aureliasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule half-hour product preview + stakeholder availability

Hi Elena / Tom,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for sharing high-level priorities around latency, cost, and model governance. Per our discovery, a short product preview would help your engineering and procurement teams validate fit before we dive into technical evals.

Goal: 30-minute product preview to show runtime behavior, routing options, and a quick Q&A with an engineer.

Please pick the best window (all times PT):
- Option A: Tue Jun 11, 10:00–10:30
- Option B: Wed Jun 12, 14:00–14:30
- Option C: Thu Jun 13, 08:30–09:00

If none of these work, tell me two time blocks that do and I’ll coordinate. Also let me know who from your side should join (tech lead, procurement, security). I’ll loop in our technical lead and send a one-page agenda.

Attachments: Redwood_Product_OnePager.pdf (pdf) — quick reference.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aureliasystems.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aureliasystems.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule half-hour product preview + stakeholder availability

Jonas — thanks, that sounds perfect.

We’d like to include our Cloud Architect (Tom) and our Head of Procurement (Maya Patel, will be looped on calendar invite). Of the three options, Option B (Wed Jun 12, 14:00–14:30 PT) works best for Tom and me.

Couple of asks for the session:
- Quick demo showing how routing between hosted and dedicated works under load
- 5 minutes on observability/console and cost tracking

Looking forward to the preview.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi | Head of Platform Engineering
Aurelia Systems
elena.rossi@aureliasystems.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aureliasystems.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aureliasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule half-hour product preview + stakeholder availability

Thanks Elena — confirmed for Wed Jun 12, 14:00–14:30 PT. I’ve tentatively blocked the slot on our side.

Karthik (cc’d) will lead the demo and cover the routing/observability pieces; Marissa will join for next-step planning and licensing questions.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- 0:00–2:00 quick intros and session goals
- 2:00–12:00 live preview: hosting modes + routing demo
- 12:00–20:00 observability, cost controls, and batching examples
- 20:00–27:00 technical Q&A (Karthik)
- 27:00–30:00 next steps & wrap (Marissa)

Attachments: proposed-agenda.docx (docx) — feel free to suggest edits.

I’ll send a calendar invite with the meeting link and include Maya once you share her email (or add her to the invite).

If you want a short pre-read, I can share a quick note on the routing policy options we discussed.

Best,
Jonas
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@aureliasystems.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aureliasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@aureliasystems.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule half-hour product preview + stakeholder availability

Thanks Jonas — calendar invite accepted. I added Maya (procurement). Looking forward to Karthik’s demo — we are especially keen to see per-route token cost breakdowns and how prefix caching might help our use case.

See you on Wed.

—Tom
Tom Nguyen | Cloud Architect
Aurelia Systems
